name: MyShare
tagline: Upload photos and documents to a server on user request
blurb: MyShare is an Android share target that sends photos and documents to a user-configured server over HTTP POST.
description:
MyShare is an Android share target that sends photos and documents to a user-configured server over HTTP POST.

It uploads only content explicitly shared by the user and does not use ads, analytics, tracking, or proprietary services.
